download_and_unzip_cli: run a python script to download a zip file from a URL and extract it to a destination directory
download_and_unzip_main: create a python function that downloads a zip file from a URL and extracts it to a specified destination
download_and_unzip_requests_get: build a python module that uses requests to download a file from a URL and save it to a temporary file
download_and_unzip_zipfile_extract: create a python function that extracts all files from a zip archive to a specified destination directory
download_and_unzip_tempfile: build a python script that uses a temporary file to store a downloaded zip file before extraction
